_doc: The laws of each realm (systems/laws.js; the Laws panel ui/actionMenu/laws.js). Each law has options; a realm's law is set on kingdom.laws (saved with the realm). Until a ruler sets one, a realm keeps its old custom: share[option] of realms hold each (a hash of the realm, the same all game). Only the ruler of a realm may change its law: each change costs changeCost.treasury from the crown's treasury and changeCost.stability of the realm's stability (folk dislike upheaval), plus the option's own stability (adopting a hard law costs more), and a law may be changed again only after cooldownDays. Every law is read by the game: privatePrisons by systems/knockout.js (a private citizen may drag the beaten off to their prison camp only where it's allowed); foreignLand by systems/lots.js (where only subjects may hold land, a stranger can't buy a lot or a house, nor rent one); punishment by systems/streetCrime.js and systems/underworld.js (arrests: fines and days in the cells) (the watch's fines and days in the cells, × fine and × jail) and by systems/knockout.js (× deter: the chance that whoever downs you finishes you or goes through your purse, and that one who hates you sets on you at home); vice by systems/gangs.js (what the gangs' gambling dens take, the crackdown they draw, and the licence the crown takes).

local._doc: A town's own ordinances (Laws.localVice): settlement.ordinances.vice = 'forbidden' | 'follow', set by whoever holds the town; until then a town keeps its old custom, a hash of the town (banShare of towns ban dice and cards whatever the realm allows). A town may be stricter than its realm, never laxer.

backRooms._doc: Where gaming is forbidden (the realm's vice law, or the town's own ban: Laws.gambling) no gaming house opens: the tavern's tables, the town's Gambling Den and a tavern of yours can't run dice openly. Dice go underground, behind a legitimate front (systems/backRooms.js): a gang's den runs in the back of a real business in town (fronts), and a tavern of yours can be fitted with a hidden back room (fitCost) where its tables earn as before. Getting in: one of the gang, or a guild hand, walks in; anyone else pays the doorman (doorFee, x strangerFee for a stranger with no contact), the fee into the gang's purse. Each day you sit down there the watch may raid (raidBase + raidPerCrackdown x the town's crackdown, x boughtCaptain if the gang has bought the captain): the stakes on the table are lost, a fine (fine x the realm's punishment law) to the town's purse, and heat. A back room in your own tavern risks a raid each night (tavernRaid, the same scaling): a fine, its tables seized (seizeShare), heat.

privatePrisons.name: Private Prisons
privatePrisons.desc: May a private citizen keep a prison camp, and put those they take to work?

forbidden.label: Forbidden
forbidden.desc: Only the crown keeps prisoners. Whoever takes a captive must hand them to the watch.

allowed.label: Allowed
allowed.desc: Free folk may keep prison camps and work their prisoners. Those who set on you may drag you off to theirs.

foreignLand.name: Land for Foreigners
foreignLand.desc: May those not sworn to the realm buy building lots and houses in its towns?

open.label: Open to all
open.desc: Anyone with the coin may buy a lot or a house, or rent one.

subjects.label: Subjects only
subjects.desc: Only those sworn to the realm may buy or rent land and houses in its towns.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.desc: How hard the watch comes down on brawlers and worse: the fines and the days in the cells.

lenient.label: Lenient
lenient.desc: Lighter fines, shorter stays in the cells. Those who would rob or kill a fallen man fear the law less.

standard.label: Customary
standard.desc: The fines and sentences of long custom.

harsh.label: Harsh
harsh.desc: Heavy fines and long sentences. The streets are quieter; the people grumble.

vice.name: Gaming & Vice
vice.desc: Dice dens, card tables and back rooms: does the crown hunt them, wink at them, or license them?

forbidden.label: Forbidden
forbidden.desc: Dens are hunted. They take less and the watch's crackdown runs hotter wherever they open.

tolerated.label: Tolerated
tolerated.desc: The watch looks the other way, so long as nobody is killed in one.

licensed.label: Licensed
licensed.desc: Dens may trade openly for a licence: they take more, the crackdown eases, and a fifth of their take goes to the crown's treasury.

pestilence.name: Pestilence
pestilence.desc: When sickness goes round a town, do its gates stay open to travellers and trade, or are they shut? (systems/illness.js: a sick town under quarantine passes a case on to the realm's other towns, and takes one in, at a fraction of the usual rate. Every realm keeps its gates open by custom; only a ruler who proclaims it shuts them.)

open.label: Gates open
open.desc: Trade and travellers come and go, and the sickness with them.

quarantine.label: Quarantine
quarantine.desc: A town with sickness going round shuts its gates: hardly a case gets in or out. Merchants and the shut-in grumble.
